title: Tesla recalls 3 million cars as part of China-wide push to stop hidden door handles | TechCrunch
summary: All 11 companies will also push software updates as part of the recall. Manual door releases have become a problem in recent years as automakers like Tesla made electronic door latches the standard way of getting in and out of a car.
